basis: The DPA supplements and forms part of the Supabase Terms of Service or other applicable Agreement.
The DPA is effective as of the Effective Date of the Agreement.
The Terms state that the Agreement takes effect by clicking acceptance or by accessing/using the Services.

roleAssessment.customerRole: controller/business for Covered Data; processor where acting for its own controller
roleAssessment.vendorRole: processor/service provider for Covered Data; subprocessor where Customer is itself a processor
roleAssessment.scopeLimitation: Does not classify every Supabase account, support, telemetry or usage-data flow outside the Covered Data scope.

contractualMechanismsObserved: EU Standard Contractual Clauses incorporated conditionally by the DPA
transferAssessment.note: DPA/SCC incorporation is not a completed transfer impact assessment and does not establish EU-only processing.

regionAssessment.contractualFinding: Customer-selected region is the storage and primary processing location subject to DPA exceptions; Supabase and subprocessors may process Covered Data where facilities are maintained.

limitations: The prior owner-confirmed gap record is preserved as historical evidence and is not rewritten.
Durable restricted-vault locators for the controller-provided Supabase DPA and Terms copies should be registered before a strict enterprise evidence gate treats artifact custody as complete.
Subprocessor and concrete international-transfer/TIA verification are separate evidence work.
